target: the cap IS the figure preflight_gate assumed, so the printed estimate is an upper bound and --effort changes what the call can actually spend
cmd: D="$PWD/req.json"; cat "$FIXTURES/sol-transport/brief.json" | MOCK_RESPONSE_FILE="$FIXTURES/sol-transport/openrouter-with-cost.json" SOL_REQUEST_DUMP="$D" bash "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/call_sol.sh" --mode adversary --via openrouter --effort standard >/dev/null 2>&1; S=$(jq -r '.max_tokens' "$D"); D="$PWD/req.json"; cat "$FIXTURES/sol-transport/brief.json" | MOCK_RESPONSE_FILE="$FIXTURES/sol-transport/openrouter-with-cost.json" SOL_REQUEST_DUMP="$D" bash "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/call_sol.sh" --mode adversary --via openrouter --effort max >/dev/null 2>&1; M=$(jq -r '.max_tokens' "$D"); echo "standard=$S max=$M"; [ "$S" = 8000 ] && [ "$M" = 16000 ] && echo CAP_TRACKS_EFFORT
_note: The caps budget for hidden reasoning, not visible text. Measured live 2026-08-10: a 2000 cap produced 2000 billed output tokens and an empty message — the entire budget went to reasoning before the envelope started.
